name: What is the process for planning kitchen electrical and lighting with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning kitchen electrical and lighting with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for planning kitchen electrical and lighting starts with an initial consultation to understand your needs and review your kitchen design. We then develop a detailed electrical and lighting plan, ensuring compliance with local codes and integrating with your appliance layout. Process clarity is key: we provide a clear proposal, coordinate with other trades, and manage inspections. Throughout, we aim to ensure the electrical plan supports both the aesthetic and functional goals of your kitchen remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves initial consultation, detailed electrical/lighting plan development, proposal, coordination with trades, and managing inspections to meet your design goals.
